maddeler.e: لَا حَياءَ فِي الدِّينِ • (lā ḥayāʔa fī d-dīni)
maddeler.t: Literally: “There is no abashment in religion”, meaning that there is no hindrance against speaking frankly of sensitive matters when these are relevant to questions of religious law.
g: One should not be ashamed of talking about bodily, sexual, or other sensitive matters if this is necessary; naturalia non sunt turpia
